# teams_cortana_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing CortanaPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_cortana_ambient_listening` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowCortanaAmbientListening parameter.
- `allow_cortana_in_context_suggestions` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowCortanaInContextSuggestions parameter.
- `allow_cortana_voice_invocation` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowCortanaVoiceInvocation parameter.
- `cortana_voice_invocation_mode` (String) Maps to the -CortanaVoiceInvocationMode parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
